author: permaculturegeek
body:
Big Cactus (and it's T10 replacement Fey Cactus\*) are great for horde content so long as you are using the tamer spec to boost action rate. Against single enemies, action rate drops, and volley attacks have low penetration - so not a good choice for PVP, world, raids, or non-horde dungeons.

My go-to at T8 (and some of T9) was Illuyanka, Made of Stone, but that won't be around for a month or three yet. (Dragon attacks, water attacks, blights - so you equip the matching spells)

Ideally as Valhallan you want to equip an instrument (or other weapon with balanced attack and magic) - if there was a good T8 one I never got it!

\*Once you can afford Replica Selene, she will replace Fey Cactus, with stronger attacks and buffs.

author: Cptnwhizbang
body: Steward Cactus is great at T8. The gazer is also super strong at that tier, as is Dark Dragon, depending on event resistances. War Horse is always strong if you have one at your tier.

author: 3rategy
body: Basilisk and Cockatrice are really good for T8 summoner. Get buggane if you can, he's super game breaking. Ward of mythril, golem fortitude, barrier 2,and gait of hildr are your best friends for defensive buffs.
